label: sdc02_0230_dragonbb_01
text: Here we are, Ms. B.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_01
text: Thank you all for coming.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_02
text: I’m pleased to inform you that some very special\nguests are here to see you today.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_03
text: They left for a tour of the school mere minutes\nago, but I believe they’ll return soon enough.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_04
text: In the meantime, I’ll fill you all in on the situation.\nPlease have a seat.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_dragonbb_02
text: Don’t mind if I do. These knees are creakin’.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0230_sister_01
text: Oh please. You’re not old enough for that yet![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_06
text: I’d heard you were busy battling your way up the\nBB League...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_07
text: But to think you’d make it as far as Champion!\nWhat a dazzling accomplishment![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_select_01
text: Thank you so much!

label: sdc02_0230_select_02
text: Thanks, I guess...

label: sdc02_0230_sister_02
text: Sorry, Ms. Briar, but could we leave all that for\nanother time?\c\nWhat’s this thing you wanted to tell us about?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_08
text: My apologies... That was insensitive of me.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_09
text: Let me get straight to today’s topic, then.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_10
text: I want all of you here to join me...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_11
text: on an expedition to the secluded and\nmysterious [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Area Zero[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_sister_03
text: Area Zero?! That’s that place in Paldea you\nwanted to visit, right? You got permission?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_12
text: My main goals are to investigate the Terastal\nphenomenon and to gather samples of the\r\ncrystals present in the crater.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_13
text: But to be honest, I also have one more ambition\nfor this trip.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_14
text: I’m hoping that we can find [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Terapagos[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], the\nLegendary Pokémon slumbering in Area Zero![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_brother_02
text: ...Terapagos? A Legendary Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_01
text: A rather exciting idea, isn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_15
text: There you are, Geeta! I was just getting the\nkids up to speed.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_02
text: I do apologize for my tardiness.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_select_03
text: La Primera!

label: sdc02_0230_select_04
text: Ms. Geeta!

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hm? Champion [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?
I
certainly
didn’t
expect
to
run
into
you
here...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_04
text: Ah, of course. You must be participating in the\nstudent exchange program.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_dragonbb_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)] just got crowned our
new
BB
League
Champion, too.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_05
text: Your talent is as brilliant as always, I see. Truly a\nwonderful thing.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_06
text: If you’ll be going along, then I suppose that\nbodes well...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_07
text: Is it all right if I explain the situation to the\nchildren, Briar?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_16
text: By all means.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_08
text: First, allow me to introduce myself.\c\nMy name is Geeta. I am the chairwoman of\nthe Pokémon League in Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_09
text: More than a decade ago, the Pokémon League\nprovided support for research on Area Zero—the\r\ngreat crater at the center of Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_10
text: Once that research was complete, we shifted\nour duties to monitoring and managing the area.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_11
text: Area Zero is full of mysteries—and also danger.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_12
text: Generally speaking, the area is off-limits, even\nfor research.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_13
text: That being said...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_14
text: Recently, we’ve had to confront the possibility\nthat dangerous Pokémon could escape the area.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_15
text: There’s a clear need for further research—\nand quickly.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_16
text: But at our Pokémon League, we’ve had\ntrouble finding capable personnel—not to\r\nmention time—to study Area Zero.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_17
text: You reached out to me, as I’ve been requesting\naccess to the area for quite some time now.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_18
text: I apologize that we are not better equipped to\ndeal with this ourselves.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_19
text: Blueberry Academy has a wealth of highly skilled\nTrainers with well-trained Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_20
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]And with Champion [VAR 0x0100(0000)]
also
on
the
team,
I’d
know
I
could
safely
initiate
a
new
expedition.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_18
text: This is entirely voluntary, of course, but it would\nbe very reassuring to have you with us![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_19
text: What do you say? Will you join our little team\nas we explore Area Zero?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_select_05
text: I’m in!

label: sdc02_0230_select_06
text: I dunno...

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_21
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Splendid. Well said, Champion\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_22
text:
I’m afraid I must insist that you go along,
Champion [VAR 0x0100(0000)].\c
You have been to the depths of Area Zero
already, after all.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_sister_04
text: Uh, well... I think it’s already decided that I’m\ngoing.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_20
text: Your support will be very useful as always,\nCarmine. I appreciate having you on board.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_dragonbb_04
text: Sorry, but I’ll pass on this one.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0230_dragonbb_05
text: The League Club’s a whole mess right now.\nWe need my steady hand on the wheel here.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0230_sister_05
text: Suuure. You just can’t be bothered to travel all\nthe way to Paldea, can you?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0230_dragonbb_06
text: Heh heh. Guilty.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0230_dragonbb_07
text: I’m curious what our mighty ex-Champion is\nthinking, though.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0230_brother_04
text: If there’s a Legendary Pokémon there, I want to\nfind it...and catch it. This time...I won’t let this\r\nchance go.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0230_dragonbb_08
text: Interesting.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_21
text:
Then it’s decided!\c
It’s too bad that Drayton won’t be joining us, but
it seems the team will consist of Carmine, Kieran,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)], and myself.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_23
text: You have my thanks for your help on this matter.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_chairman_24
text: I look forward to the great findings that you will\nno doubt bring back![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_22
text: I’m grateful for the opportunity, Geeta. Leave it\nto me.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_23
text: My dream of exploring Area Zero is finally\nbecoming a reality![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0230_bbteacher_24
text: Now, time to prepare! Let’s meet by the bridge\nat the academy entrance as soon as we’re ready![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
